Prefer gesture recognizers when application behavior is expressed as taps, drags, or scales
Use `Listener` only for behavior that genuinely needs raw pointer events
Remove pointer routes when their owner is disposed or the sequence ends
Keep global pointer routes short-lived, lightweight, and side-effect aware
Do not assume that handling an event stops delivery to later hit test entries
Clear pressed, dragging, and capture-like state when a pointer is cancelled
Register pointer-signal candidates through the resolver instead of making every target act
Use `AbsorbPointer` when the blocking widget should remain the hit-test target
Use `IgnorePointer` when the subtree should be absent from pointer hit testing
Test overlapping targets, cancellation, and scroll signals on representative input devices
